evidence: Touches BlockTemplateManager and getblocktemplate cache logic with the Mining label.
rationale: Encapsulates function-local static cache into BlockTemplateManager and eliminates lifetime issues in multi-node test setups. The description notes that 'cached CBlockIndex* can outlive the ChainstateManager that owns it' and this refactoring moves global state into the node context as part of #33758 while enabling unit testing of cache invalidation.
